messages:
maya: Customer 'Clara Foods' invoice autopay failing — payment page attempts to open SCA modal but merchant reports it never appears. Stripe logs show 'challenge_failed' and frontend console logs: "Blocked a frame with origin 'https://payments.clara' from accessing a cross-origin frame." Repro steps included.

 tess: Merchant requires PO number in invoice metadata; they also said this started after a small cookie/iframe change last week.

 alex: Got a sample payment_intent_id pi_3JXabc123 — in our logs the acquirer sometimes returns `insufficient_funds` and sometimes `challenge_failed`. Sending log snippet to thread.

 daniel: Hypothesis: hosted SCA modal depends on a third-party cookie from payments.redwood-infer.com with `SameSite=None; Secure`. If the merchant's CSP or browser blocks third-party cookies or frame embedding, ACS can't persist the session and the challenge fails/loops.

 maya: Merchant repro: open invoice -> click autopay -> modal spinner -> nothing. Tried Chrome Incognito and it fails there too.

 alex: Quick repro curl to check session cookie behavior:
```
curl -v 'https://payments.redwood-infer.com/session?pi=pi_3JXabc123' \
  -H 'Origin: https://app.clarafoods.com'
```
Look for `Set-Cookie` in the response headers.

 daniel: Also check merchant CSP `frame-ancestors` — their current CSP is `frame-ancestors 'self'` which blocks our iframe when payments are embedded. Asking merchant to add `https://payments.redwood-infer.com` to allow-list.

 tess: @maya I asked the merchant to whitelist payments host and to enable third-party cookies for the domain. They tested and reported autopay succeeded once after the whitelist.

 maya: Closing loop — merchant confirmed whitelist fix resolved the modal-blocking issue in their environment. We'll continue to monitor for `insufficient_funds` patterns separately and reopen if challenge failures reappear. :white_check_mark:

 infra-bot: deploy succeeded for payments-iframe v1.4.2 at 2468009940
